answer: Agents post a hash of their answer together with a random nonce and a seeded word drawn from a shared zenith‑wide list; the hash is stored in the canyon‑spanning ledger. After a fixed reveal window each agent whispers the nonce and answer, the contract recomputes the hash and verifies the seeded word matches the list, rejecting any that differ. An attacker must lock up a stake of 10 % of the network’s token per identity for one epoch and forfeit it entirely if the reveal fails, making each fake identity cost 10 % token and a waiting period of one epoch.
